full_page.content:
1954, April 16
The following is a faithful transcription of an autograph on a photo by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F. M. Cap.
Below the picture of himself he has written:
Still only half converted - at it since Oct. 1870. In front of St. Felix Chapel.
- Fr. Solanus.
On the reverse side of the picture he has written:
April 16th Good Friday 1954
Rational mortal: - 2nd Q. Why did God make you?
God made me to know Him. O What a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. Its Heaven-begun for the grateful, on earth. - To treasure a'right! ? Highest Heaven its worth.
There is nothing more rational in reason than to love God. By stifling reason and gratitude sin begets atheism. Atheism? The unqualified climax at once of intellectual insanity, of moral degeneracy, of diabolical blasphemy .
Holy Saturday. God bless you Margaret - you and yours. I hope you keep well these days. .... Ah! days, as it would seem when atheism - the voice of Anti Christ - is demanding and get- ting a hearing. Barabas still prefered ?.
Bless'd be God in all- Fr. Solanus
(above was received from Helena Wilhite Groth)
